edition: NeuroTranslate 0.0 • Daily and Sports Activities • five placements • TRAIN development 1

activities.a10: walking on a flat treadmill at 4 km/h

measure: XYZ acceleration in the selected unit's local sensor frame, in the dataset's stored units. No common world/anatomical frame, gravity removal, pose or joint-angle interpretation.
support: 480 TRAIN members; 3360 windows per placement. History ends at cutoff; target is the same placement and file at cutoff + 3. Keep person, activity and row IDs for auditing only. No window concatenation, interpolation, zero filling, other-placement input or inference about missing placements. Standardize each placement/axis from that placement's complete TRAIN input histories only (float64 mean and population SD).
learner: One fresh seeded instance of the general HandArmLearner with five distinct named source encoders, embeddings, residual Gaussian heads and normalizers. One shared temporal transformer, fusion, forecast decoder and AdamW optimizer. Alternate independently shuffled homogeneous placement batches, all five per cycle. Validate forecast origin, source, file, pairing and requested/measured time before each optimizer step. Fit the diagonal Gaussian likelihood in normalized coordinates. CPU float32.
baselines: Persistence repeats the last observed XYZ. Each placement gets its own float64 ridge model predicting displacement from flattened standardized 16x3 histories, with unpenalized intercept and penalty 0.001 times the number of windows in the normal equations. These two baselines and the shared model score the same raw XYZ targets, including all four people. Report the independent stored single-arm direct-transformer comparator on its existing task (right arm) as well; do not invent corresponding direct models for other regions.
report: Report ordered TRAIN raw stored-unit MAE per axis, placement, person and activity for every method. Give row counts. A superiority claim on a placement needs smaller scalar MAE than each available baseline for each person; report failures. Reload parity, holdout exclusion, finite values and correct source/row alignment are mandatory. Report descriptive 95% marginal Gaussian interval coverage/width on TRAIN. No validation, generalization, new-subject accuracy, live camera, real-time latency, neural or clinical claim.
resources: One CPU process, 1 BLAS and interop thread, CPU-only torch, no loader workers. Compare 1 and 2 intraop on fixed synthetic histories and fixed core pair before fit; choose faster valid route. GPU kernels unavailable in this learner. Fixed epochs and final checkpoint. No hyperparameter search, test-based selection or repeated real fit.
